title: EDSA Shrine Prayer for Peace
contentText: Lord Jesus, we come to you in our need. Create in us an awareness of the massive forces of conflict that threaten our world today. Activate in us the forces of goodness, justice, love, and peace. Where there is poverty, let there be dignified living and just structures. Help us build your kingdom of peace. Our Lady, Queen of Peace, pray for us.

title: Birhen ng EDSA Prayer-Anthem
contentText: Sa 'yo, Mahal na Birhen ng EDSA, hiling namin ay kapayapaan. Mula sa gapos ng kaapihan, kami'y hinango mo at iniligtas. Walang dugo, walang dahas, kundi dasal at pag-ibig lamang. Sa rosaryo mo, Mahal na Birhen, nagkaisa kami sa EDSA.

contentText: Lord, you have blessed your land and forgiven your people. End your grievance against us and restore our life. Through the intercession of Mary, Queen of Peace, heal our nation and unite us in truth and charity.

title: EDSA Rosary Intentions
contentText: We offer this Rosary for honest governance, the welfare and safety of OFWs, the protection of human rights, and the strengthening of democratic institutions. Grant our leaders conversion of heart and a commitment to justice and peace.

title: Prayers for Healing the Land
